module: Manages the big map markers: groups the raw gameplay POIs (points of interest) from gameplay_rawPois that have a bigmapMarker into clusters according to a radius, creates one marker per cluster (gameplay/markers/bigmapMarker), updates/displays them every frame and detects which marker is hovered by the mouse or the reticle. Used by freeroam_bigMapMode; a modder does not normally touch it.
notes: A "filter" (setupFilter) = grouping radius + list of valid POI ids. Its identifier is "radius#-concatenated ids"; old filters stay in memory and their markers are faded out then cleaned up.
Clusters are recomputed when the generation of gameplay_rawPois increases (getAllClustersBySettings).
Bug/inconsistency: M.buildPoiList = buildPoiList references a local variable that is never defined, so it is nil.
displayBigMapMarkers starts with profilerPopEvent("BigMapMarkers parkingSpeedFactor") with no matching push in this file (leftover from old profiling code).
The fields iconCounter, iconsById and printNext exist but are not used in this file (debug).

In clusterBySettings, a POI never contains a .cluster before merging, so each cluster in practice only gets its starting POI (neighbors within the radius are only added if bmi.cluster is set); behavior to check in game.

buildPoiList.desc: Always nil (reference to an undefined variable).

iconCounter.desc: Icon counter, initialized to 0 (not used in this file).

clearMarkers.desc: Destroys the render objects of all markers (current and old) and empties the lists.

displayBigMapMarkers.desc: To be called every frame while the big map is displayed: updates all markers of the active filter's clusters (displayed) and of the previous filters (faded out), as well as the old markers that are disappearing.

getAllClustersBySettings.desc: Returns (computing if needed) the POI clusters for a filter: POIs whose id is valid and that have a bigmapMarker, sorted by id, grouped by quadtree then merged via bigmapMarker.merge.

settingsId.desc: Filter identifier created by setupFilter (internally named currentClusterSettingsId).

returns.desc: List of clusters (fields id, containedIds, containedIdsLookup...).

getClusterMarker.desc: Returns a cluster's marker, creating it if it does not exist (or reusing the old marker with the same id).

getIdsFromHoveredPoiId.desc: For a POI id, returns the ids of all the POIs in its cluster in the active filter.

returns.desc: Ids contained in the cluster, nil if the POI is in no cluster.

handleMouse.desc: Determines which cluster is hovered: casts a ray from the mouse (if it moved) or from the camera center, and tests the ray/icon distance with a sphere whose radius depends on the zoom (fov) and distance (or is fixed in an orthographic camera). Does nothing in gamepad mode when a POI is already selected.

mouseMoved.desc: true if the ray comes from the mouse, false if from the camera.

poiIsSelected.desc: true if a POI is already selected.

returns.desc: Id of the first POI of the hovered cluster, nil otherwise.

hideMarkers.desc: Hides (fades out) all current and old markers, without destroying them.

setNextMarkersFullAlphaInstant.desc: Makes the active markers appear instantly at full opacity on the next update (only once).

setupFilter.desc: Sets the active filter: the grouping radius is rounded to a multiple of 5 (20 by default), the ids are sorted, and the current markers are moved to the old list and hidden for a smooth transition. Invisible old markers are destroyed.

validIds.desc: POI ids to display (the table is sorted in place).

radius.desc: Grouping radius in world meters (20 by default).
